result.summary: The screen is generally well laid out, but there is one clear visual defect: a loading spinner is stuck over the food photo in the 'Popular right now' ramen card, making that image look broken.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with a green arc is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar food image, obscuring the meal photo and appearing as if the image failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded, or replace it with a subtle skeleton/placeholder that doesn't cover the food image.
